# Study Overview

## Design

**Study Type**: Within-subject controlled trial

**Total Participants**: 9 (P01-P07, P09-P11)

**Exclusions**: - P11: Complete exclusion (study dropout due to infection) - P10 Session 5: Excluded (light automation malfunction) - P07: Excluded from statistical analysis (negative melatonin suppression)

## Study Phases

### Phase 1: Pre-Ambulatory Period

-   Duration: 7 days
-   Setting: At home
-   Measurements: Sleep logs, ActLumus, ActiGraph, CGM

### Phase 2: In-Laboratory Period

-   Duration: 10-13 days
-   Daily protocol: Arrival 5.5h before habitual bedtime (HBT); Depature 0.5h before HBT
-   Light conditions:
    -   **D (Dim)**: 10 lx continuously
    -   **B (Bright)**: 10 lx → 1000 lx (1.5h) → 10 lx
-   Salivary melatonin every 30 minutes, starting 30 minutes after chamber entry

### Phase 3: Post-Ambulatory Period

-   Duration: 7 days
-   Setting: At home (identical to Phase 1)

## Participant Groups

### Group 1 (HBT 00:00)

-   Participants: P01, P02, P03
-   Light sequence: DDDBBBDDBDB (11 sessions)

### Group 2 (HBT 22:00)

-   Participants: P04, P05
-   Light sequence: DBBBDDDBDB (10 sessions)

### Group 3 (HBT 23:30)

-   Participants: P06, P07, P09
-   Light sequence: DBBBDDDBDB (10 sessions)

### Group 4 (HBT 23:00)

-   Participant: P10
-   Light sequence: DDDBXDBBBDBDD (12 valid sessions, session 5 excluded)

## Sample Count Verification

```{r sample-verification}
#| label: sample-verification

# Count samples per participant per session
samples_per_session <- melatonin %>%
  group_by(participant_id, session) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(participant_id, session)

# Filter sessions with more than 10 samples
```

**Findings**: Extra samples found for: - P05 sessions 5 and 10 (11 samples each) - P07 session 1 (11 samples)

## Data Cleaning

**Duplicate Samples:**

For P05 and P07, some samples were measured in duplicate. The duplicate samples ("b" suffix) were removed after verifying concentrations with original samples:

-   **P05 Session 5 (sample 6b)**: Identical concentration to sample 6 → Original retained
-   **P05 Session 10 (sample 4b)**: Identical concentration to sample 4 → Original retained
-   **P07 Session 1 (sample 7b)**: Identical concentration to sample 7 → Original retained
-   **P07 Session 8 (sample 807b)**: Identical concentration to sample 7 → Original retained
-   **P07 Session 2 (sample 207b)**: Discrepant concentration (Original: 0.9 pg/mL vs. Control: 0.1 pg/mL) → Original retained

```{r data-cleaning}
#| label: data-cleaning

# Remove duplicate samples and excluded participants/sessions
melatonin <- melatonin %>%
  filter(
    # Remove duplicate samples (concentrations verified)
    !(participant_id == "P05" & session == "C02_05" & sample_number == "6b"),
    !(participant_id == "P05" & session == "C02_10" & sample_number == "4b"),
    !(short_sample_id == "P07_807b"),
    !(short_sample_id == "P07_207b"),
    !(participant_id == "P07" & session == "C03_01" & sample_number == "7b"),
    !(participant_id == "P11"),
    !(participant_id == "P10" & session == "C04_05")
  )

# Verify the changes
verification <- melatonin %>%
  filter(participant_id %in% c("P05", "P07")) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, session) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(participant_id, session)

knitr::kable(verification, 
             caption = "Verification: P05 and P07 sample counts after cleaning")
```

## Time Format Conversion

```{r time-conversion}
#| label: time-conversion

# Convert time format
if (is.numeric(melatonin$time)) {
  melatonin$time <- hms::as_hms(melatonin$time * 86400)
} else if (inherits(melatonin$time, "POSIXt")) {
  melatonin$time <- hms::as_hms(melatonin$time)
} else {
  melatonin$time <- hms::as_hms(hms::hms(melatonin$time))
}

# Add experimental session and time in hours
melatonin <- melatonin %>%
  arrange(participant_id, date_collected) %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  mutate(
    exp_session = as.integer(str_extract(session, "(?<=_)\\d+$")),
    time_hours = hour(time) + minute(time)/60 + second(time)/3600
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Time Range Validation

**Expected vs. Actual Time Ranges:**

Most sessions show times slightly outside the defined ranges due to the practical duration of sample collection and documentation. However, systematic time formatting errors were identified in the following sessions:

**Time Formatting Errors (corrected in next step based on handwritten protocols):**

-   **P04 Session 3**: 05:04 → should be 20:04 (+15 hours)
-   **P05 Session 3**: 05:04 → should be 20:04 (+15 hours)
-   **P06 Session 10**: 06:32 → should be 20:32 (+14 hours)
-   **P07 Session 10**: 06:32 → should be 20:32 (+14 hours)
-   **P09 Session 10**: 06:32 → should be 20:32 (+14 hours)

These errors likely occurred during Excel import/export and were verified against handwritten laboratory protocols.

```{r time-validation}
#| label: time-validation

# Check time range per evening
time_ranges <- melatonin %>%
  group_by(participant_id, exp_session, session) %>%
  summarise(
    min_time_hours = min(time_hours),
    max_time_hours = max(time_hours),
    n_samples = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    first_sample_time = sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(min_time_hours), 
                                round((min_time_hours %% 1) * 60)),
    last_sample_time = sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(max_time_hours), 
                               round((max_time_hours %% 1) * 60)),
    duration_hours = round(max_time_hours - min_time_hours, 2)
  )

# Define expected time ranges
time_limits <- data.frame(
  participant_id = c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10"),
  min_hour = c(19, 19, 19, 17, 17, 18.5, 18.5, 18.5, 18),
  max_hour = c(23.5, 23.5, 23.5, 21.5, 21.5, 23, 23, 23, 22.5)
)

# Check for sessions outside defined ranges
sessions_outside <- time_ranges %>%
  mutate(
    min_time_hours = as.numeric(substr(first_sample_time, 1, 2)) + 
      as.numeric(substr(first_sample_time, 4, 5))/60,
    max_time_hours = as.numeric(substr(last_sample_time, 1, 2)) + 
      as.numeric(substr(last_sample_time, 4, 5))/60
  ) %>%
  left_join(time_limits, by = "participant_id") %>%
  filter(min_time_hours < min_hour | max_time_hours > max_hour)

if(nrow(sessions_outside) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(sessions_outside, 
               caption = "Sessions with times outside expected ranges (before correction)")
}
```

## Time Error Correction

```{r time-correction}
#| label: time-correction

# Correct documented time errors
melatonin <- melatonin %>%
  mutate(
    time = case_when(
      participant_id %in% c("P04", "P05") & exp_session == 3 & time_hours < 10 ~ 
        hms::as_hms(as.numeric(time) + 15*3600),
      participant_id %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") & exp_session == 10 & time_hours < 10 ~ 
        hms::as_hms(as.numeric(time) + 14*3600),
      TRUE ~ time
    ),
    time_hours = case_when(
      participant_id %in% c("P04", "P05") & exp_session == 3 & time_hours < 10 ~ 
        time_hours + 15,
      participant_id %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") & exp_session == 10 & time_hours < 10 ~ 
        time_hours + 14,
      TRUE ~ time_hours
    )
  )

# Verify corrections
corrected_sessions <- melatonin %>%
  filter(
    (participant_id %in% c("P04", "P05") & exp_session == 3) |
    (participant_id %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") & exp_session == 10)
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, exp_session) %>%
  summarise(
    min_time = sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(min(time_hours)), 
                      round((min(time_hours) %% 1) * 60)),
    max_time = sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(max(time_hours)), 
                      round((max(time_hours) %% 1) * 60)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(corrected_sessions, 
             caption = "Corrected time ranges for affected sessions")
```

```{r light-patterns}
  P03 = strsplit("DDDBBBDDBDB", "")[[1]],

  P05 = strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", "")[[1]],
  P06 = strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", "")[[1]],
  P07 = strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", "")[[1]],
  P09 = strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", "")[[1]],

)

# Convert sample_number to integer

  mutate(sample_num = as.integer(sample_number))
```

# AUC Calculations

## Full Evening AUC (5-hour exposure)

```{r auc-full}
#| label: auc-full

# Calculate AUC per evening using trapezoidal rule
auc_per_evening <- melatonin %>%
  arrange(participant_id, exp_session, time_hours) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, exp_session, session) %>%
  summarise(
    auc_melatonin = trapz(time_hours, melatonin_concentration),
    n_samples = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(participant_id, exp_session)

# Add light condition
auc_with_condition <- auc_per_evening %>%
  mutate(
    light_condition = case_when(
      participant_id == "P01" ~ light_patterns$P01[exp_session],
      participant_id == "P02" ~ light_patterns$P02[exp_session],
      participant_id == "P03" ~ light_patterns$P03[exp_session],
      participant_id == "P04" ~ light_patterns$P04[exp_session],
      participant_id == "P05" ~ light_patterns$P05[exp_session],
      participant_id == "P06" ~ light_patterns$P06[exp_session],
      participant_id == "P07" ~ light_patterns$P07[exp_session],
      participant_id == "P09" ~ light_patterns$P09[exp_session],
      participant_id == "P10" ~ light_patterns$P10[exp_session]
    )
  )

# Display summary statistics
summary_auc <- auc_with_condition %>%
  group_by(light_condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_auc = mean(auc_melatonin),
    sd_auc = sd(auc_melatonin),
    min_auc = min(auc_melatonin),
    max_auc = max(auc_melatonin),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(summary_auc, digits = 2,
             caption = "Summary statistics: Full evening AUC by light condition")
```

## Experimental Window AUC (Samples 7-9, 1.5-hour exposure)

```{r auc-experimental}
#| label: auc-experimental

# Filter to samples 7-9 (experimental window)
melatonin_experimental_samples <- melatonin %>%

auc_experimental_samples <- melatonin_experimental_samples %>%
  arrange(participant_id, exp_session, time_hours) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, exp_session, session) %>%
  summarise(
    auc_melatonin_exp = trapz(time_hours, melatonin_concentration),

      participant_id == "P07" ~ light_patterns$P07[exp_session],
      participant_id == "P09" ~ light_patterns$P09[exp_session],
      participant_id == "P10" ~ light_patterns$P10[exp_session]
    )
  )

# Display summary statistics
summary_auc_exp <- auc_exp_with_condition %>%
  group_by(light_condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_auc = mean(auc_melatonin_exp),

    max_auc = max(auc_melatonin_exp),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(summary_auc_exp, digits = 2,
             caption = "Summary statistics: Experimental window AUC by light condition")
```

## Individual AUC Values per Participant and Session

```{r auc-individual-table}
#| label: auc-individual-table

# Combine full evening and experimental window AUC
auc_combined <- auc_with_condition %>%
  select(participant_id, exp_session, light_condition, 
         auc_full_5h = auc_melatonin) %>%
  left_join(
    auc_exp_with_condition %>% 
      select(participant_id, exp_session, auc_exp_1.5h = auc_melatonin_exp),
    by = c("participant_id", "exp_session")
  ) %>%
  arrange(participant_id, exp_session)

# Display table
DT::datatable(
  auc_combined,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    order = list(list(0, 'asc'), list(1, 'asc'))
  ),
  caption = "Individual AUC values: Full 5h vs. Experimental 1.5h window",
  rownames = FALSE
) %>%
  DT::formatRound(columns = c('auc_full_5h', 'auc_exp_1.5h'), digits = 2) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    'light_condition',
    backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(c('D', 'B'), c('#e3f2fd', '#fff3e0'))
  )
```

# Individual Melatonin Profiles

## Individual Time-Course Plots (Panel View)

```{r individual-profiles-function}
#| label: individual-profiles-function

# Function to create melatonin profile plot
create_melatonin_profile <- function(participant_id, light_pattern) {
  
  # Prepare data
  p_data <- melatonin %>%
    filter(participant_id == !!participant_id) %>%
    mutate(
      light_condition = rep(light_pattern, each = 10)[1:n()],
      hours_before_hbt = 5.5 - (as.numeric(sample_number) * 0.5)
    )
  
  # Get AUC values
  p_auc <- auc_per_evening %>%
    filter(participant_id == !!participant_id) %>%
    mutate(
      light_condition = light_pattern,
      auc_label = paste0("AUC=", round(auc_melatonin, 1)),
      exp_session = as.integer(exp_session)
    )
  
  # Determine y-axis limit
  max_y <- max(p_data$melatonin_concentration, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_limit <- ceiling(max_y / 10) * 10
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(p_data, aes(x = hours_before_hbt, y = melatonin_concentration)) +
    geom_area(fill = "#4A90E2", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_rect(xmin = 5, xmax = 2, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
              fill = "#E3F2FD", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_rect(data = p_auc %>% filter(light_condition == "B"),
              aes(xmin = 2.5, xmax = 1, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
              fill = "#FFE0B2", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2.5) +
    geom_text(data = p_auc,
              aes(x = 5, y = Inf, label = auc_label),
              hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3, size = 3.5,
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_x_reverse(
      breaks = 0:5,
      limits = c(5.3, 0.2),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, y_limit),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ exp_session, ncol = 4,
               labeller = labeller(exp_session = function(x) {
                 idx <- as.numeric(x)
                 light <- p_auc$light_condition[idx]
                 paste0("Evening ", x, " (", light, ")")
               })) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Salivary melatonin per evening (", participant_id, ")"),
      x = "Hours before HBT [h]",
      y = "Salivary melatonin [pg/mL]"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

## P10 (Group 4) - Special Case

```{r profile-p10}
#| label: fig-profile-p10
#| fig-cap: "Salivary melatonin per evening - P10 (Session 5 excluded)"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9

# Prepare data for P10 (excluding session 5)
p10_data <- melatonin %>%
  filter(participant_id == "P10" & exp_session != 5) %>%
  mutate(
    hours_before_hbt = 5.5 - (as.numeric(sample_number) * 0.5),
    light_condition = case_when(
      exp_session %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "D",
      exp_session == 4 ~ "B",
      exp_session == 6 ~ "D",
      exp_session %in% c(7, 8, 9) ~ "B",
      exp_session == 10 ~ "D",
      exp_session == 11 ~ "B",
      exp_session %in% c(12, 13) ~ "D"
    )
  )

# Get AUC values for P10 (excluding session 5)
p10_auc <- auc_per_evening %>%
  filter(participant_id == "P10" & exp_session != 5) %>%
  mutate(
    light_condition = case_when(
      exp_session %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "D",
      exp_session == 4 ~ "B",
      exp_session == 6 ~ "D",
      exp_session %in% c(7, 8, 9) ~ "B",
      exp_session == 10 ~ "D",
      exp_session == 11 ~ "B",
      exp_session %in% c(12, 13) ~ "D"
    ),
    auc_label = paste0("AUC=", round(auc_melatonin, 1)),
    exp_session = as.integer(exp_session)
  )

# Determine y-axis limit
max_y <- max(p10_data$melatonin_concentration, na.rm = TRUE)
y_limit <- ceiling(max_y / 10) * 10

# Create plot for P10
ggplot(p10_data, aes(x = hours_before_hbt, y = melatonin_concentration)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#4A90E2", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_rect(xmin = 5, xmax = 2, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
            fill = "#E3F2FD", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_rect(data = p10_auc %>% filter(light_condition == "B"),
            aes(xmin = 2.5, xmax = 1, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "#FFE0B2", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = p10_auc,
            aes(x = 5, y = Inf, label = auc_label),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3, size = 3.5,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_reverse(
    breaks = 0:5,
    limits = c(5.3, 0.2),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, y_limit),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ exp_session, ncol = 4,
             labeller = labeller(exp_session = function(x) {
               session_num <- as.numeric(x)
               light <- p10_auc$light_condition[p10_auc$exp_session == session_num]
               paste0("Evening ", x, " (", light, ")")
             })) +
  labs(
    title = "Salivary melatonin per evening (P10)",
    subtitle = "Session 5 excluded due to light automation malfunction",
    x = "Hours before HBT [h]",
    y = "Salivary melatonin [pg/mL]"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10), color = "grey40"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Individual Melatonin Suppression

```{r suppression-calculation}
#| label: suppression-calculation

# Calculate mean AUC by condition (FULL 5H)
mean_auc_by_condition <- auc_with_condition %>%
  group_by(participant_id, light_condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_auc = mean(auc_melatonin, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate suppression
melatonin_suppression <- mean_auc_by_condition %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = light_condition, values_from = mean_auc, names_prefix = "mean_auc_") %>%
  mutate(suppression_percent = (1 - mean_auc_B / mean_auc_D) * 100)

knitr::kable(melatonin_suppression, digits = 2,
             caption = "Individual melatonin suppression - Full 5h window (%)")
```

```{r suppression-plot}
#| label: suppression-plot
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Individual melatonin suppression by bright light"

# Assign groups
melatonin_suppression_grouped <- melatonin_suppression %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      participant_id %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ "Group 1",
      participant_id %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ "Group 2",
      participant_id %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ "Group 3",
      participant_id == "P10" ~ "Group 4"
    )
  )

# Plot
ggplot(melatonin_suppression_grouped, 
       aes(x = reorder(participant_id, suppression_percent), 
           y = suppression_percent, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", suppression_percent)),
            vjust = ifelse(melatonin_suppression_grouped$suppression_percent >= 0, -0.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833", "#CCBB44")) +
  labs(title = "Melatonin suppression by bright light (1000 lx)",
       subtitle = "Full 5h evening window",
       x = "Participant", y = "Suppression (%)", fill = "Group") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Doublet Analysis

### Data Preparation

```{r doublet-data-prep}
#| label: doublet-data-prep

# Define light patterns for groups
light_g1 <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBBBDDBDB", ""))
light_g2 <- unlist(strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", ""))
light_g4_orig <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBXDBBBDBDD", ""))

# Create doublet dataframes
df_doublets_g1 <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g1) - 1),
  session_end = 2:length(light_g1),
  doublet = paste0(light_g1[-length(light_g1)], light_g1[-1])
)

df_doublets_g2 <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g2) - 1),
  session_end = 2:length(light_g2),
  doublet = paste0(light_g2[-length(light_g2)], light_g2[-1])
)

df_doublets_g4_orig <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g4_orig) - 1),
  session_end = 2:length(light_g4_orig),
  doublet = paste0(light_g4_orig[-length(light_g4_orig)], light_g4_orig[-1])
)

df_doublets_g4 <- df_doublets_g4_orig %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(doublet, "X"))

# Create doublet position mappings
doublet_positions_g1 <- df_doublets_g1 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

doublet_positions_g2 <- df_doublets_g2 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

doublet_positions_g4 <- df_doublets_g4 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Function to calculate doublet positions
calc_doublet_positions <- function(participant_id, auc_data, doublet_map) {
  results <- doublet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_auc = mean(auc_data$auc_melatonin[auc_data$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_auc = mean(auc_data$auc_melatonin[auc_data$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, doublet, pos1_auc, pos2_auc)
  
  return(results)
}

# Function for experimental window
calc_doublet_positions_exp <- function(participant_id, auc_data_exp, doublet_map) {
  results <- doublet_map %>% 
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_auc_exp = mean(auc_data_exp$auc_melatonin_exp[auc_data_exp$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], 
                          na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_auc_exp = mean(auc_data_exp$auc_melatonin_exp[auc_data_exp$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], 
                          na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, doublet, pos1_auc_exp, pos2_auc_exp)
  
  return(results)
}

# Calculate doublet AUC for all participants - FULL 5H
participants <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")
doublets <- c("DD", "DB", "BD", "BB")

df_plot <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_auc = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants) {
  # Select appropriate doublet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g2
  } else {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g4
  }
  
  # Get AUC data
  auc_data <- auc_per_evening %>%
    filter(participant_id == p) %>%
    select(exp_session, auc_melatonin)
  
  # Join with doublets
  auc_doublets <- df_doublets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(auc_data, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per doublet
  mean_auc_doublets <- auc_doublets %>%
    group_by(doublet) %>%
    summarise(mean_auc = mean(auc_melatonin, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data
  for(d in doublets) {
    if(d %in% mean_auc_doublets$doublet) {
      df_plot <- rbind(df_plot, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        participant = p,
        mean_auc = mean_auc_doublets$mean_auc[mean_auc_doublets$doublet == d]
      ))
    }
  }
}

df_plot$doublet <- factor(df_plot$doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB"))

# Calculate doublet AUC - EXPERIMENTAL WINDOW (1.5h)
participants_exp <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")

df_plot_exp <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_auc_exp = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants_exp) {
  # Select appropriate doublet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g2
  } else {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g4
  }
  
  # Get experimental AUC data
  auc_data_exp <- auc_experimental_samples %>%
    filter(participant_id == p) %>%
    select(exp_session, auc_melatonin_exp)
  
  # Join with doublets
  auc_doublets_exp <- df_doublets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(auc_data_exp, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per doublet
  mean_auc_doublets_exp <- auc_doublets_exp %>%
    group_by(doublet) %>%
    summarise(mean_auc_exp = mean(auc_melatonin_exp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data
  for(d in doublets) {
    if(d %in% mean_auc_doublets_exp$doublet) {
      df_plot_exp <- rbind(df_plot_exp, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        participant = p,
        mean_auc_exp = mean_auc_doublets_exp$mean_auc_exp[mean_auc_doublets_exp$doublet == d]
      ))
    }
  }
}

df_plot_exp$doublet <- factor(df_plot_exp$doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB"))
```

### Line Plot: Position Comparison (5-hour)

```{r doublet-lineplot-5h}
#| label: fig-doublet-lineplot-5h
#| fig-cap: "Doublet position comparison (5-h exposure, P07 excluded)"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

# Calculate position data for all participants (excluding P07)
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")

mean_doublet_pos_noP07 <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  position = character(),
  mean_auc = numeric(),
  sd_auc = numeric(),
  n_participants = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(d in doublets) {
  for(pos in c("pos1", "pos2")) {
    values <- c()
    for(p in participants_noP07) {
      # Select mapping
      if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g1
      } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g2
      } else {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g4
      }
      
      # Get AUC data
      auc_data <- auc_per_evening %>%
        filter(participant_id == p)
      
      # Calculate positions
      pos_auc <- calc_doublet_positions(p, auc_data, doublet_map)
      
      # Extract value
      if(d %in% pos_auc$doublet) {
        if(pos == "pos1") {
          values <- c(values, pos_auc$pos1_auc[pos_auc$doublet == d])
        } else {
          values <- c(values, pos_auc$pos2_auc[pos_auc$doublet == d])
        }
      }
    }
    
    if(length(values) > 0) {
      mean_doublet_pos_noP07 <- rbind(mean_doublet_pos_noP07, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        position = pos,
        mean_auc = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_auc = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_participants = length(values)
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Prepare for plotting
df_plot_positions_noP07 <- mean_doublet_pos_noP07 %>%
  mutate(
    position_label = ifelse(position == "pos1", "Position 1", "Position 2"),
    position_num = ifelse(position == "pos1", 1, 2),
    light_type = ifelse(position == "pos1", 
                        substr(doublet, 1, 1),
                        substr(doublet, 2, 2)),
    light_label = ifelse(light_type == "D", "dim", "bright")
  ) %>%
  mutate(doublet = factor(doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB")))

# Define colors
light_colors <- c("dim" = "#4A90E2", "bright" = "#F5A623")

# Create plot
ggplot(df_plot_positions_noP07, 
       aes(x = position_num, y = mean_auc, group = doublet)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(color = light_label), size = 5, shape = 16) +
  scale_color_manual(values = light_colors,
                     labels = c("dim" = "Dim (10 lx)", "bright" = "Bright (1000 lx)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), 
                     labels = c("Position 1", "Position 2"),
                     limits = c(0.8, 2.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Melatonin levels across light exposure doublets",
    subtitle = "Mean melatonin AUC across all participants (5-h exposure; P07 excluded)",
    x = "Doublet position",
    y = "Mean AUC melatonin (pg/mL × h)",
    color = "Light condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r doublet-descriptives-combined}
#| label: doublet-descriptives-combined

# Calculate statistics for 5-h exposure
doublet_stats_5h <- df_plot_noP07 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(

  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(

# Combine both exposure windows

# Display as formatted table
knitr::kable(

) %>%
```

## Triplet Analysis

### Data Preparation

```{r triplet-data-prep}
#| label: triplet-data-prep

# Define light patterns (redefine to ensure they exist)
light_g1 <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBBBDDBDB", ""))
light_g2 <- unlist(strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", ""))
light_g4_orig <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBXDBBBDBDD", ""))

# Function to calculate triplet positions
calc_triplet_positions <- function(participant_id, auc_data, triplet_map, auc_col) {
  triplet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_auc = mean(auc_data[[auc_col]][auc_data$session %in% position1_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_auc = mean(auc_data[[auc_col]][auc_data$session %in% position2_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos3_auc = mean(auc_data[[auc_col]][auc_data$session %in% position3_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, triplet, pos1_auc, pos2_auc, pos3_auc)
}

# Define triplet mappings for Group 1
df_triplets_g1 <- data.frame(
  session_1 = 1:(length(light_g1)-2),
  session_2 = 2:(length(light_g1)-1),
  session_3 = 3:length(light_g1),
  triplet = sapply(1:(length(light_g1)-2), function(i) paste0(light_g1[i:(i+2)], collapse = ""))
)

triplet_positions_g1 <- df_triplets_g1 %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_1),
    position2_sessions = list(session_2),
    position3_sessions = list(session_3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Define triplet mappings for Group 2
df_triplets_g2 <- data.frame(
  session_1 = 1:(length(light_g2)-2),
  session_2 = 2:(length(light_g2)-1),
  session_3 = 3:length(light_g2),
  triplet = sapply(1:(length(light_g2)-2), function(i) paste0(light_g2[i:(i+2)], collapse = ""))
)

triplet_positions_g2 <- df_triplets_g2 %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_1),
    position2_sessions = list(session_2),
    position3_sessions = list(session_3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate for all participants - FULL 5H
participants <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")
triplets_all <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")

df_triplet_plot <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_auc_pos3 = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants) {
  # Get AUC data with session column
  auc_data <- auc_per_evening %>%
    filter(participant_id == p) %>%
    mutate(session = exp_session)
  
  # Select appropriate triplet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09")) {
    triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g2
  } else {
    # P10 special handling
    df_triplets_g4_trip <- data.frame(
      session_1 = 1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2),
      session_2 = 2:(length(light_g4_orig)-1),
      session_3 = 3:length(light_g4_orig),
      triplet = sapply(1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2), function(i) paste0(light_g4_orig[i:(i+2)], collapse = ""))
    ) %>%
      filter(!str_detect(triplet, "X")) %>%
      filter(session_1 != 5 & session_2 != 5 & session_3 != 5)
    
    triplet_map <- df_triplets_g4_trip %>%
      group_by(triplet) %>%
      summarise(
        position1_sessions = list(session_1),
        position2_sessions = list(session_2),
        position3_sessions = list(session_3),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
  
  # Calculate triplets
  triplet_auc <- calc_triplet_positions(p, auc_data, triplet_map, "auc_melatonin")
  
  # Add to plot data
  for(t in triplets_all) {
    if(t %in% triplet_auc$triplet) {
      df_triplet_plot <- rbind(df_triplet_plot, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        participant = p,
        mean_auc_pos3 = triplet_auc$pos3_auc[triplet_auc$triplet == t]
      ))
    }
  }
}

df_triplet_plot$triplet <- factor(df_triplet_plot$triplet,
                                  levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD",
                                            "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB"))

# Calculate for experimental window - EXCLUDING P07
participants_exp <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")

df_triplet_plot_exp <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_auc_pos3_exp = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants_exp) {
  # Get experimental AUC data with session column
  auc_data_exp <- auc_experimental_samples %>%
    filter(participant_id == p) %>%
    mutate(session = exp_session)
  
  # Select appropriate triplet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
    triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g2
  } else {
    # P10 special handling
    df_triplets_g4_trip <- data.frame(
      session_1 = 1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2),
      session_2 = 2:(length(light_g4_orig)-1),
      session_3 = 3:length(light_g4_orig),
      triplet = sapply(1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2), function(i) paste0(light_g4_orig[i:(i+2)], collapse = ""))
    ) %>%
      filter(!str_detect(triplet, "X")) %>%
      filter(session_1 != 5 & session_2 != 5 & session_3 != 5)
    
    triplet_map <- df_triplets_g4_trip %>%
      group_by(triplet) %>%
      summarise(
        position1_sessions = list(session_1),
        position2_sessions = list(session_2),
        position3_sessions = list(session_3),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
  
  # Calculate triplets
  triplet_auc_exp <- calc_triplet_positions(p, auc_data_exp, triplet_map, "auc_melatonin_exp")
  
  # Add to plot data
  for(t in triplets_all) {
    if(t %in% triplet_auc_exp$triplet) {
      df_triplet_plot_exp <- rbind(df_triplet_plot_exp, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        participant = p,
        mean_auc_pos3_exp = triplet_auc_exp$pos3_auc[triplet_auc_exp$triplet == t]
      ))
    }
  }
}

df_triplet_plot_exp$triplet <- factor(df_triplet_plot_exp$triplet,
                                      levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD",
                                                "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB"))
```

```{r triplet-boxplot-5h}
# Labels with bold third letter

    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

```{r triplet-lineplot-5h}
#| label: fig-triplet-lineplot-5h
#| fig-cap: "Triplet position comparison (5-h exposure, P07 excluded)"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

# Calculate mean across participants for each position (excluding P07)
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")

df_triplet_positions_noP07 <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  position = integer(),
  mean_auc = numeric(),
  light_type = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(t in triplets_all) {
  for(pos in 1:3) {
    values <- c()
    for(p in participants_noP07) {
      # Get AUC data
      auc_data <- auc_per_evening %>%
        filter(participant_id == p) %>%
        mutate(session = exp_session)
      
      # Select mapping
      if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g1
      } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g2
      } else {
        df_triplets_g4_trip <- data.frame(
          session_1 = 1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2),
          session_2 = 2:(length(light_g4_orig)-1),
          session_3 = 3:length(light_g4_orig),
          triplet = sapply(1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2), function(i) paste0(light_g4_orig[i:(i+2)], collapse = ""))
        ) %>%
          filter(!str_detect(triplet, "X")) %>%
          filter(session_1 != 5 & session_2 != 5 & session_3 != 5)
        
        triplet_map <- df_triplets_g4_trip %>%
          group_by(triplet) %>%
          summarise(
            position1_sessions = list(session_1),
            position2_sessions = list(session_2),
            position3_sessions = list(session_3),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
      }
      
      # Calculate
      triplet_auc <- calc_triplet_positions(p, auc_data, triplet_map, "auc_melatonin")
      
      if(t %in% triplet_auc$triplet) {
        if(pos == 1) values <- c(values, triplet_auc$pos1_auc[triplet_auc$triplet == t])
        if(pos == 2) values <- c(values, triplet_auc$pos2_auc[triplet_auc$triplet == t])
        if(pos == 3) values <- c(values, triplet_auc$pos3_auc[triplet_auc$triplet == t])
      }
    }
    
    if(length(values) > 0) {
      light_letter <- substr(t, pos, pos)
      df_triplet_positions_noP07 <- rbind(df_triplet_positions_noP07, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        position = pos,
        mean_auc = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        light_type = ifelse(light_letter == "D", "dim", "bright")
      ))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r triplet-descriptives-combined}
    n_5h = n(),
    median_5h = median(mean_auc_pos3, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_5h = IQR(mean_auc_pos3, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate statistics for 1.5-h exposure
triplet_stats_1.5h <- df_triplet_plot_exp %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    n_1.5h = n(),
    median_1.5h = median(mean_auc_pos3_exp, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_1.5h = IQR(mean_auc_pos3_exp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Combine both exposure windows
triplet_stats_combined <- triplet_stats_5h %>%
  full_join(triplet_stats_1.5h, by = "triplet") %>%
  arrange(triplet)

# Display as formatted table
knitr::kable(
  triplet_stats_combined,
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c("Triplet", "N", "Median", "IQR", "N", "Median", "IQR"),
  caption = "Descriptive statistics for triplet third-day melatonin AUC across exposure windows (P07 excluded)",
  align = c("l", rep("r", 6))
) %>%
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "5-h Exposure" = 3, "1.5-h Exposure" = 3))
```

## Time-Course Analysis

```{r timecourse-data}
#| label: timecourse-data

# Map light conditions to each session 
df_light <- bind_rows(
  # All participants except P10
  bind_rows(lapply(names(light_patterns), function(p) {
    pattern <- light_patterns[[p]]
    data.frame(
      participant_id = p,
      exp_session = seq_along(pattern),
      light = pattern,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })),
  # P10 manually
  data.frame(
    participant_id = "P10",
    exp_session = 1:13,
    light = ifelse(1:13 %in% c(1,2,3,6,10,12,13), "D", "B"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)

# Join with melatonin data
df_melatonin_light <- melatonin %>%
  filter(participant_id %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")) %>%
  inner_join(df_light, by = c("participant_id", "exp_session"))

# Calculate per-participant summary
df_summary_per_participant <- df_melatonin_light %>%
  group_by(participant_id, sample_num, light) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_melatonin = mean(melatonin_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_melatonin = sd(melatonin_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_melatonin = sd_melatonin / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(light = factor(light, levels = c("D", "B"), labels = c("Dim", "Bright")))

# Grand average excluding P07
df_summary_noP07 <- df_summary_per_participant %>%
  filter(participant_id != "P07")

grand_summary_manual <- data.frame()

for(s in unique(df_summary_noP07$sample_num)) {
  for(l in levels(df_summary_noP07$light)) {
    vals <- df_summary_noP07 %>%
      filter(sample_num == s, light == l) %>%
      pull(mean_melatonin)
    
    n_val <- length(vals)
    mean_val <- mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_val <- sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    se_val <- sd_val / sqrt(n_val)
    
    grand_summary_manual <- rbind(grand_summary_manual, data.frame(
      sample_num = s,
      light = l,
      mean_melatonin = mean_val,
      sd_melatonin = sd_val,
      n = n_val,
      se_melatonin = se_val
    ))
  }
}

grand_summary_manual$light <- factor(grand_summary_manual$light, 
                                     levels = c("Bright", "Dim"))
```

```{r timecourse-plot}
#| label: fig-timecourse
#| fig-cap: "Melatonin time course - grand average across participants (P07 excluded)"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

# Ensure sample_num is numeric
grand_summary_manual <- grand_summary_manual %>%
  mutate(sample_num = as.numeric(sample_num))

# Define labels
hbt_values <- c("5", "4.5", "4", "3.5", "3", "2.5", "2", "1.5", "1", "0.5")

# Y-axis limits
y_min <- floor(min(grand_summary_manual$mean_melatonin - grand_summary_manual$se_melatonin, 
                   na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 - 0.1
y_max <- ceiling(max(grand_summary_manual$mean_melatonin + grand_summary_manual$se_melatonin, 
                     na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1

# Create plot
ggplot(grand_summary_manual, 
       aes(x = sample_num, y = mean_melatonin, 
           color = light, fill = light, group = light)) +
  # Background shading
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1, xmax = 6, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 6, xmax = 9, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "#FFF9E6", alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 9, xmax = 10, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  # Labels
  annotate("text", x = 3, y = y_max - 0.05, label = "dim (10 lx)", 
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 7.5, y = y_max - 0.05, label = "intervention\n(10 or 1000 lx)", 
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "#B8860B", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 9.5, y = y_max - 0.05, label = "dim (10 lx)", 
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
  # Ribbon for SE
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_melatonin - se_melatonin,
                  ymax = mean_melatonin + se_melatonin),
              alpha = 0.1, color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # Line and points
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 16) +
  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000 lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10 lx)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000 lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10 lx)")
  ) +
  # Axes
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:10,
    labels = paste0("S", 1:10, "\n(", hbt_values, "h)"),
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Melatonin time course",
    subtitle = "Grand average across participants (P07 excluded, n=8)",
    x = "Sample number (hours before HBT)",
    y = "Mean melatonin concentration (pg/mL)",
    color = "Light condition",
    fill = "Light condition"
  ) +
  # Theme
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(15, 10, 10, 10)
  )
```

## Triplet Time-Course Analysis

### Data Preparation
```{r}
# Get session 3 data for each triplet
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")
triplets_all <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")

# Function to get session 3 for each triplet type
get_triplet_session3 <- function(p, triplet_type) {
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g2
  } else {
    df_triplets <- data.frame(
      session_1 = 1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2),
      session_2 = 2:(length(light_g4_orig)-1),
      session_3 = 3:length(light_g4_orig),
      triplet = sapply(1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2), function(i) 
        paste0(light_g4_orig[i:(i+2)], collapse = ""))
    ) %>%
      filter(!str_detect(triplet, "X")) %>%
      filter(session_1 != 5 & session_2 != 5 & session_3 != 5)
  }
  
  sessions_3 <- df_triplets %>%
    filter(triplet == triplet_type) %>%
    pull(session_3)
  
  return(sessions_3)
}

# Function to get all participant-session combinations for a triplet
get_triplet_sessions_overview <- function(triplet_type) {
  overview <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      for(s in sessions_3) {
        overview <- rbind(overview, data.frame(
          participant_id = p,
          session = s
        ))
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(overview %>% arrange(session, participant_id))
}

# Function to create plot for one triplet type
plot_triplet_timecourse <- function(triplet_type) {
  df_triplet_samples <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      p_data <- melatonin %>%
        filter(participant_id == p, exp_session %in% sessions_3) %>%
        select(participant_id, sample_num, melatonin_concentration)
      
      df_triplet_samples <- rbind(df_triplet_samples, p_data)
    }
  }
  
  triplet_summary <- df_triplet_samples %>%
    group_by(sample_num) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_melatonin = mean(melatonin_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_melatonin = sd(melatonin_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(sample_num = as.numeric(sample_num))
  
  y_min <- floor(min(triplet_summary$mean_melatonin - triplet_summary$sd_melatonin, 
                     na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 - 0.1
  y_max <- ceiling(max(triplet_summary$mean_melatonin + triplet_summary$sd_melatonin, 
                       na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1
  
  hbt_values <- c("5", "4.5", "4", "3.5", "3", "2.5", "2", "1.5", "1", "0.5")
  
  # Determine third letter and intervention color/label
  third_letter <- substr(triplet_type, 3, 3)
  intervention_color <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", "#F5F5F5", "#FFF9E6")
  intervention_alpha <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", 0.4, 0.8)
  intervention_label <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", "dim (10 lx)", "bright (1000 lx)")
  
  # Create title with bold third letter
  triplet_first_two <- substr(triplet_type, 1, 2)
  triplet_third <- substr(triplet_type, 3, 3)
  
  p <- ggplot(triplet_summary, aes(x = sample_num, y = mean_melatonin)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 1, xmax = 6, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 6, xmax = 9, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = intervention_color, alpha = intervention_alpha) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 9, xmax = 10, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = 3, y = y_max - 0.05, label = "dim (10 lx)", 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
    annotate("text", x = 7.5, y = y_max - 0.05, label = intervention_label, 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, 
             color = ifelse(third_letter == "D", "grey50", "#B8860B"), 
             fontface = "italic") +
    annotate("text", x = 9.5, y = y_max - 0.05, label = "dim (10 lx)", 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_melatonin - sd_melatonin,
                    ymax = mean_melatonin + sd_melatonin),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 16, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:10,
      labels = paste0("S", 1:10, "\n(", hbt_values, "h)"),
      limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = bquote("Melatonin time course - Triplet " * 
                     .(triplet_first_two) * bold(.(triplet_third))),
      subtitle = paste0("Grand average third-day (n=", 
                       length(unique(df_triplet_samples$participant_id)), 
                       " participants; P07 excluded)"),
      x = "Sample number (hours before HBT)",
      y = "Mean melatonin concentration (pg/mL)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"),
```

```{r}
  )
```

### Panel Plot: All Triplets with Unified Y-Axis
```{r}
# Prepare data for all triplets
triplets_all_panel <- c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB")

df_all_triplets_unified <- data.frame()

for(triplet_type in triplets_all_panel) {
  df_triplet_samples <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      p_data <- melatonin %>%
        filter(participant_id == p, exp_session %in% sessions_3) %>%
        select(participant_id, sample_num, melatonin_concentration) %>%
        mutate(triplet = triplet_type)
      
      df_triplet_samples <- rbind(df_triplet_samples, p_data)
    }
  }
  
  df_all_triplets_unified <- rbind(df_all_triplets_unified, df_triplet_samples)
}

# Calculate summary per triplet
triplet_summary_unified <- df_all_triplets_unified %>%
  group_by(triplet, sample_num) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_melatonin = mean(melatonin_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_melatonin = sd(melatonin_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_num = as.numeric(sample_num),
    triplet = factor(triplet, levels = triplets_all_panel),
    triplet_type = ifelse(substr(triplet, 3, 3) == "D", "Dim", "Bright")
  )

# Unified Y-axis limits for ALL triplets
y_min_unified <- floor(min(triplet_summary_unified$mean_melatonin - triplet_summary_unified$sd_melatonin, 
                           na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 - 0.1
y_max_unified <- ceiling(max(triplet_summary_unified$mean_melatonin + triplet_summary_unified$sd_melatonin, 
                             na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1

# Create unified panel plot
ggplot(triplet_summary_unified, aes(x = sample_num, y = mean_melatonin)) +
  geom_rect(aes(fill = triplet_type), 
            xmin = 6, xmax = 9, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1, xmax = 6, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 9, xmax = 10, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_melatonin - sd_melatonin,
                  ymax = mean_melatonin + sd_melatonin),
              alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 16, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dim" = "#F5F5F5", "Bright" = "#FFF9E6"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:10,
    labels = c("S1\n(5h)", "S2", "S3\n(4h)", "S4", "S5\n(3h)", 
               "S6", "S7\n(2h)", "S8", "S9\n(1h)", "S10"),
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_unified, y_max_unified), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_wrap(~ triplet, ncol = 4, 
             labeller = labeller(triplet = function(x) {
               sapply(x, function(t) {
                 first_two <- substr(t, 1, 2)
                 third <- substr(t, 3, 3)
                 paste0(first_two, third)
               })
             })) +
  labs(
    title = "Melatonin time course - All triplets",
    subtitle = "Grand average third-day (P07 excluded)",
    x = "Sample number (hours before HBT)",
    y = "Mean melatonin concentration (pg/mL)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 10, 10, 10)
  )
```

### Grand Average with D-ending and B-ending rows
```{r fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Prepare data for all triplets
triplets_all_panel <- c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB")

df_all_triplets_unified <- data.frame()

for(triplet_type in triplets_all_panel) {
  df_triplet_samples <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      p_data <- melatonin %>%
        filter(participant_id == p, exp_session %in% sessions_3) %>%
        select(participant_id, sample_num, melatonin_concentration) %>%
        mutate(triplet = triplet_type)
      
      df_triplet_samples <- rbind(df_triplet_samples, p_data)
    }
  }
  
  df_all_triplets_unified <- rbind(df_all_triplets_unified, df_triplet_samples)
}

# Calculate summary per triplet
triplet_summary_unified <- df_all_triplets_unified %>%
  group_by(triplet, sample_num) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_melatonin = mean(melatonin_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_melatonin = sd(melatonin_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_num = as.numeric(sample_num),
    triplet = factor(triplet, levels = triplets_all_panel)
  )

# Unified Y-axis limits
y_min_unified <- floor(min(triplet_summary_unified$mean_melatonin - triplet_summary_unified$sd_melatonin, 
                           na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 - 0.1
y_max_unified <- ceiling(max(triplet_summary_unified$mean_melatonin + triplet_summary_unified$sd_melatonin, 
                             na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1

# Function to create triplet plot
create_triplet_plot_mel <- function(triplet_name, show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE) {
  data_triplet <- triplet_summary_unified %>%
    filter(triplet == triplet_name)
  
  triplet_third <- substr(triplet_name, 3, 3)
  intervention_color <- ifelse(triplet_third == "D", "#F5F5F5", "#FFF9E6")
  intervention_alpha <- ifelse(triplet_third == "D", 0.4, 0.8)
  
  # Only third letter bold: DD**D**
  triplet_first_two <- substr(triplet_name, 1, 2)
  triplet_label <- paste0(triplet_first_two, "**", triplet_third, "**")
  
  hbt_values <- c("5", "4.5", "4", "3.5", "3", "2.5", "2", "1.5", "1", "0.5")
  
  ggplot(data_triplet, aes(x = sample_num, y = mean_melatonin)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 1, xmax = 6, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 6, xmax = 9, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = intervention_color, alpha = intervention_alpha) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 9, xmax = 10, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_melatonin - sd_melatonin, 
                    ymax = mean_melatonin + sd_melatonin),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 16, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:10,
      labels = if(show_x) c("S1\n(5h)", "S2", "S3\n(4h)", "S4", "S5\n(3h)", 
                            "S6", "S7\n(2h)", "S8", "S9\n(1h)", "S10") else 1:10,
      limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_unified, y_max_unified), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = triplet_label,
      x = NULL,
      y = if(show_y) "Mean melatonin\nconcentration ± SD (pg/mL)" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_markdown(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 5)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    )
}

# Create D-ending triplet plots (no x-axis labels)
p_DDD_mel <- create_triplet_plot_mel("DDD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE)
p_BDD_mel <- create_triplet_plot_mel("BDD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
p_DBD_mel <- create_triplet_plot_mel("DBD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
p_BBD_mel <- create_triplet_plot_mel("BBD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)

# Create B-ending triplet plots (with x-axis labels)
p_DDB_mel <- create_triplet_plot_mel("DDB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = TRUE)
p_BDB_mel <- create_triplet_plot_mel("BDB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE)
p_DBB_mel <- create_triplet_plot_mel("DBB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE)
p_BBB_mel <- create_triplet_plot_mel("BBB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE)

# Grand Average plot (same size as individual panels)
p_grand_mel <- ggplot(grand_summary_manual, 
       aes(x = sample_num, y = mean_melatonin,

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),

  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),

  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(

    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_unified, y_max_unified), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Grand Average",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = "Light condition"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 2.5)),
    fill = "none"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 5)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),

# Empty spacer
p_spacer <- ggplot() + theme_void()

# Combine in layout:

(p_DDD_mel | p_BDD_mel | p_DBD_mel | p_BBD_mel | p_grand_mel) /
```

# Data Preparation for Statistical Analysis

## Define Study Parameters

```{r}
#| label: lmm-data-prep

# Define participant list and light patterns
participant_list <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")

# Combine melatonin data with light information
melatonin_glmm <- map_dfr(participant_list, ~{
  df <- auc_experimental_samples %>% 
    filter(participant_id == .x)
  
  light_df <- tibble(
    exp_session = seq_along(light_patterns[[.x]]),
    Light_Lag0 = light_patterns[[.x]]
  )
  
  df <- df %>% 
    left_join(light_df, by = "exp_session") %>%
    rename(auc_melatonin_exp = auc_melatonin_exp)
  
  return(df)
})

# Build lagged light variables and filter valid triplets
melatonin_glmm <- melatonin_glmm %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  arrange(exp_session) %>%
  mutate(
    Light_Lag1 = lag(Light_Lag0, 1),
    Light_Lag2 = lag(Light_Lag0, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Light_Lag0) & !is.na(Light_Lag1) & !is.na(Light_Lag2)) %>%
  filter(!(participant_id == "P10" & exp_session %in% c(6, 7))) %>%
  mutate(
    Light_Lag0_num = ifelse(Light_Lag0 == "D", 0, 1),
    Light_Lag1_num = ifelse(Light_Lag1 == "D", 0, 1),
    Light_Lag2_num = ifelse(Light_Lag2 == "D", 0, 1)
  )

# Add participant demographics
participant_demographics <- tibble(
  participant_id = c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10"),
  sex = c("female", "male", "female", "female", "male", "female", "female", "female", "male"),
  age = c(24, 21, 24, 23, 31, 23, 24, 28, 32)
)

melatonin_glmm <- melatonin_glmm %>%
  left_join(participant_demographics, by = "participant_id")

# Apply exclusion criteria
melatonin_glmm <- melatonin_glmm %>%
  filter(participant_id != "P07")  # Exclude P07 (negative melatonin suppression)

# Keep only necessary variables
melatonin_glmm <- melatonin_glmm %>%
  dplyr::select(
    participant_id, exp_session, auc_melatonin_exp,
    Light_Lag0, Light_Lag1, Light_Lag2,
    Light_Lag0_num, Light_Lag1_num, Light_Lag2_num,
    sex, age
  )
```

# Statistical Analysis

### Model m0: Baseline (Random Intercept Only)

This baseline model quantifies between-participant variability without any predictors.
```{r}
#| label: model-m0-melatonin

m0_mel <- glmer(
  auc_melatonin_exp ~ 1 + (1 | participant_id),
  data = melatonin_glmm,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)

summary(m0_mel)
```

### Model m1a: Add Light Lag 0 (Current day)

This model adds the current day light exposure variable as an fixed effect with Light_Lag0_num. 
```{r}
#| label: model-m1a-melatonin

m1a_mel <- glmer(
  auc_melatonin_exp ~ 
    Light_Lag0_num +
    (1 | participant_id),
  data = melatonin_glmm,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)

summary(m1a_mel)
```

### Model m1b: Add Light Lag 1 Additionally (One Day Before)

This model adds the day before light exposure variable as an fixed effect with Light_Lag1_num. 
```{r}
#| label: model-m1b-melatonin

m1b_mel <- glmer(
  auc_melatonin_exp ~ 
    Light_Lag0_num + Light_Lag1_num +
    (1 | participant_id),
  data = melatonin_glmm,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)

summary(m1b_mel)
```

### Model m1c: Add Light Lag 2 Additionally (Two Days Before)

This model adds the light exposure two days before as an fixed effect with Light_Lag2_num. 
```{r}
#| label: model-m1c-melatonin

m1c_mel <- glmer(
  auc_melatonin_exp ~ 
    Light_Lag0_num + Light_Lag1_num + Light_Lag2_num +
    (1 | participant_id),
  data = melatonin_glmm,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)

summary(m1c_mel)
```

### Likelihood Ratio Tests: Lag Effects

```{r}
#| label: lrt-comparisons-melatonin

# Likelihood Ratio Tests for nested model comparisons
# Test whether adding each lag significantly improves model fit

# LRT 1: Does adding Lag 0 improve fit over baseline?
lrt_m0_vs_m1a <- anova(m0_mel, m1a_mel)

# LRT 2: Does adding Lag 1 improve fit over Lag 0 only?
lrt_m1a_vs_m1b <- anova(m1a_mel, m1b_mel)

# LRT 3: Does adding Lag 2 improve fit over Lag 0 + Lag 1?
lrt_m1b_vs_m1c <- anova(m1b_mel, m1c_mel)

# Display results
lrt_m0_vs_m1a
lrt_m1a_vs_m1b
lrt_m1b_vs_m1c
```
Based on the LRT results, only Lag 0 significantly improved model fit (p < 0.001), while Lag 1 (p = 0.814) and Lag 2 (p = 0.329) showed no significant improvement.Therefore, Lag 1 and Lag 2 were excluded from further model building, and only Lag 0 was retained as a predictor of melatonin AUC.

### Model m2: Add Linear Session Effect

This model adds a linear session term to account for potential temporal trends across the study.
```{r}
#| label: model-m2-melatonin

m2_mel <- glmer(
  auc_melatonin_exp ~ 
    Light_Lag0_num +
    exp_session +
    (1 | participant_id),
  data = melatonin_glmm,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)

summary(m2_mel)
```

### Model m3: Add Quadratic Session Effect

This model tests for non-linear temporal trends (e.g., U-shaped patterns) across sessions.
```{r}
#| label: model-m3-melatonin

m3_mel <- glmer(
  auc_melatonin_exp ~ 
    Light_Lag0_num +
    exp_session + I(exp_session^2) +
    (1 | participant_id),
  data = melatonin_glmm,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)

summary(m3_mel)
```

### Likelihood Ratio Tests: Session Effects
```{r}
#| label: lrt-session-effects-melatonin

# LRT 1: Does adding exp_session (linear) improve fit over Lag 0 only?
lrt_m1a_vs_m2 <- anova(m1a_mel, m2_mel)

# LRT 2: Does adding quadratic term improve fit over linear only?
lrt_m2_vs_m3 <- anova(m2_mel, m3_mel)

lrt_m1a_vs_m2
lrt_m2_vs_m3
```
Based on the LRT results, model fit was significantly improved by adding 
linear exp_session (p = 0.031), but not by adding the quadratic term 
(p = 0.182). Therefore, analysis will be proceeded with m2 (Lag 0 + linear session effect) 
to test for interaction effects in the next step.

### Model m4: Test Light × Session Interaction

This model tests whether the acute light suppression effect (Light_Lag0) changes across sessions (habituation or sensitization).
```{r}
#| label: model-m4-melatonin

m4_mel <- glmer(
  auc_melatonin_exp ~ 
    Light_Lag0_num +
    exp_session +
    Light_Lag0_num:exp_session +
    (1 | participant_id),
  data = melatonin_glmm,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)

summary(m4_mel)
```

### Likelihood Ratio Test: Light × Session Interaction
```{r}
#| label: lrt-interaction-melatonin

# LRT: Does adding the interaction improve fit over main effects only?
lrt_m2_vs_m4 <- anova(m2_mel, m4_mel)
lrt_m2_vs_m4
```
Based on the LRT results, model fit was not significantly improved by adding the interaction between Light_Lag0_num and exp_session (p = 0.707). Therefore, model m2 (main effects only) was retained for the full dataset analysis. However, comprehensive diagnostics revealed problems (see Section 8.2), leading to sensitivity analysis with influential observations excluded.

## Model SelectionSummary (full dataset) (model m2)

Based on the likelihood ratio tests and hierarchical model building strategy:

**Step 1: Testing Lag Effects**
- **m0 vs m1a**: Adding Lag 0 significantly improved fit over baseline (LRT: χ²(1) = 30.37, p < 0.001) 
- **m1a vs m1b**: Adding Lag 1 did not improve fit over Lag 0 only (LRT: χ²(1) = 0.06, p = 0.814) 
- **m1b vs m1c**: Adding Lag 2 did not improve fit over Lag 0 + Lag 1 (LRT: χ²(1) = 0.95, p = 0.329) 
- Note: Lag 2 was tested for completeness despite non-significant Lag 1
- **Decision**: Proceed with m1a (Light_Lag0_num only)

**Step 2: Testing Session Effects**
- **m1a vs m2**: Adding linear session effect significantly improved fit (LRT: χ²(1) = 4.66, p = 0.031) 
- **m2 vs m3**: Adding quadratic session term did not improve fit (LRT: χ²(1) = 1.78, p = 0.182) ✗
- **Decision**: Proceed with m2 (Light_Lag0_num + exp_session)

**Step 3: Testing Interaction**
- **m2 vs m4**: Adding Light × Session interaction did not improve fit (LRT: χ²(1) = 0.14, p = 0.707) 
- **Decision**: Retain m2 as final model

**Final Model (m2)**: 
- Predictors: Light_Lag0_num + exp_session
- Random effect: (1 | participant_id)
- AIC: 224.21
- Interpretation: Melatonin AUC is influenced by current evening light exposure and shows a linear habituation effect across sessions, with no evidence of light sensitization/habituation.

**Final Model:** Light_Lag0 + exp_session + (1 | participant_id)

### Final Basic Model Results with BH Correction (full dataset) (model m2)
```{r}
#| label: final-model-bh-melatonin

# Extract coefficients from m2
m2_coef <- summary(m2_mel)$coefficients
m2_fixed <- rownames(m2_coef)[rownames(m2_coef) != "(Intercept)"]

# Apply BH correction
m2_p_raw <- m2_coef[m2_fixed, "Pr(>|z|)"]
m2_p_bh <- p.adjust(m2_p_raw, method = "BH")

# Create results table
m2_results <- data.frame(
  Effect = m2_fixed,
  Estimate = round(m2_coef[m2_fixed, "Estimate"], 3),
  SE = round(m2_coef[m2_fixed, "Std. Error"], 3),
  t = round(m2_coef[m2_fixed, "t value"], 3),  # << GEÄNDERT: "t value" statt "z value"
  p_raw = format.pval(m2_p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
  p_BH = format.pval(m2_p_bh, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
)

# Add suppression percentage for Light_Lag0
m2_results <- m2_results %>%
  mutate(
    Suppression_pct = ifelse(
      grepl("Light_Lag0", Effect),
      paste0(round((1 - exp(Estimate)) * 100, 1), "%"),
      NA
    )
  )

kable(m2_results, 
      caption = "Final model (m2) results with Benjamini-Hochberg correction") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

```{r}
abline(h = threshold_m2, lty = 2, col = "red")
```

**Interpretation:** `r length(influential_idx)` influential observations identified. All values are biologically plausible (no statistical outliers per DHARMa).

#### Sensitivity Analysis: Exclude Influential Observations
```{r}
#| label: robust-model

# Remove influential observations
melatonin_glmm_robust <- melatonin_glmm[-influential_idx, ]

# Refit model
Melatonin_GLMM_robust <- glmer(
  auc_melatonin_exp ~ 
    Light_Lag0_num + exp_session +
    (1 | participant_id),
  data = melatonin_glmm_robust,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)

summary(Melatonin_GLMM_robust)

# Check diagnostics
sim_robust <- simulateResiduals(Melatonin_GLMM_robust, n = 1000)
plot(sim_robust)
testQuantiles(sim_robust)
```
Robustness check: Model m2_mel_robust (n = 63, excluding 4 influential observations)
Results:
 - Light effect remains highly significant and stronger (β = -1.49, p < 0.001)
 - Session effect becomes non-significant after removing influential observations (β = -0.03, p = 0.315)
- Decision: Conduct comprehensive hierarchical model building on the 
  robust dataset (excluding 4 influential observations) due to:
  1. Massively improved AIC/BIC (m2: 224.2 → m2_robust: 186.6)
  2. Significant quantile deviations in full model (p = 0.023)
  3. Need to re-evaluate session effect significance
 
## Sensitivity Analysis: Hierarchical Model Building on Robust Dataset

### Rationale

Given the identification of 4 influential observations with Cook's D > 4/n (see Check 6 above), a sensitivity analysis by repeating the entire hierarchical model building strategy on the robust dataset was performed. 

1. Assess whether model selection decisions are stable after removing influential cases
2. Evaluate whether model fit improves
3. Determine the most appropriate final model for subsequent analyses

**Note:** The robust dataset `melatonin_glmm_robust` (n = `r nrow(melatonin_glmm_robust)`) was created in Check 6 by excluding the 4 influential observations identified via Cook's Distance analysis.

---

### Final Model Results with BH Correction (m1a_robust)
```{r}
#| label: final-model-bh-m1a-robust
#| tbl-cap: "Fixed effects for final robust model with Benjamini-Hochberg correction"

# Extract coefficients
m1a_coef <- summary(m1a_robust)$coefficients
m1a_fixed <- rownames(m1a_coef)[rownames(m1a_coef) != "(Intercept)"]

# BH correction
m1a_p_raw <- m1a_coef[m1a_fixed, "Pr(>|z|)"]
m1a_p_bh <- p.adjust(m1a_p_raw, method = "BH")

# Create results table
m1a_results <- data.frame(
  Effect = m1a_fixed,
  Estimate = round(m1a_coef[m1a_fixed, "Estimate"], 3),
  SE = round(m1a_coef[m1a_fixed, "Std. Error"], 3),
  t = round(m1a_coef[m1a_fixed, "t value"], 3),  # Wie bei m2
  p_raw = format.pval(m1a_p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
  p_BH = format.pval(m1a_p_bh, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
  Suppression = paste0(round((1 - exp(m1a_coef[m1a_fixed, "Estimate"])) * 100, 1), "%")
)

kable(m1a_results, 
      col.names = c("Effect", "β (log scale)", "SE", "t", "p", "p (BH-adj)", "Suppression"),
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

**Note:** Only one predictor, therefore BH correction does not change p-value.
## Model Diagnostics for Final Robust Model (m1a_robust)

All diagnostics are performed on the robust dataset (n = 63) after 
exclusion of 4 influential observations identified in the full dataset 
analysis.

## Comparison: Full Dataset Model (m2) vs. Robust Dataset Model (m1a_robust)

To evaluate the impact of excluding influential observations, 
the final models from both datasets will be compared.

**Methodological note:** Models are fitted to datasets of different sizes 
(m2: n=67, m1a_robust: n=63). While direct AIC/BIC comparison across datasets 
has limitations, the observed improvement magnitude (ΔAIC ≈ -39) substantially 
exceeds sample size effects. Within-dataset comparison (m1a_robust vs. m2_robust) 
confirms model superiority.

---

### Model Specifications
```{r}
#| label: tbl-model-specs-comparison
#| tbl-cap: "Model specifications comparison"

data.frame(
  Aspect = c("Formula", "N observations", "N parameters", "Dataset"),
  m2_Full = c(
    "Light_Lag0 + exp_session",
    "67",
    "5",
    "Full"
  ),
  m1a_Robust = c(
    "Light_Lag0 only",
    "63",
    "4",
    "4 influential obs excluded"
  )
) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("", "m2 (Full)", "m1a_robust")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

---

### Model Fit Statistics
```{r}
#| label: tbl-fit-comparison
#| tbl-cap: "Model fit comparison"

data.frame(
  Metric = c("AIC", "BIC"),
  m2 = c(AIC(m2_mel), BIC(m2_mel)),
  m1a = c(AIC(m1a_robust), BIC(m1a_robust)),
  Delta = c(
    AIC(m1a_robust) - AIC(m2_mel),
    BIC(m1a_robust) - BIC(m2_mel)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 1))) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Metric", "m2", "m1a_robust", "Δ")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

**Result:** Robust model shows substantially better fit (ΔAIC = `r round(AIC(m1a_robust) - AIC(m2_mel), 1)`, ΔBIC = `r round(BIC(m1a_robust) - BIC(m2_mel), 1)`).

---

### Fixed Effects Comparison
```{r}
#| label: tbl-effects-comparison
#| tbl-cap: "Fixed effects estimates comparison"

coef_m2 <- summary(m2_mel)$coefficients
coef_m1a <- summary(m1a_robust)$coefficients

data.frame(
  Effect = c("Light_Lag0_num", "exp_session"),
  Beta_m2 = c(
    coef_m2["Light_Lag0_num", "Estimate"],
    coef_m2["exp_session", "Estimate"]
  ),
  p_m2 = c(
    coef_m2["Light_Lag0_num", "Pr(>|z|)"],
    coef_m2["exp_session", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  ),
  Beta_m1a = c(
    coef_m1a["Light_Lag0_num", "Estimate"],
    NA
  ),
  p_m1a = c(
    coef_m1a["Light_Lag0_num", "Pr(>|z|)"],
    NA
  ),
  Suppression = c(
    paste0(round((1 - exp(coef_m2["Light_Lag0_num", "Estimate"])) * 100, 1), "% / ",
           round((1 - exp(coef_m1a["Light_Lag0_num", "Estimate"])) * 100, 1), "%"),
    "—"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("Beta"), ~round(.x, 3)),
    across(starts_with("p"), ~format.pval(.x, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
  ) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Effect", "β (m2)", "p", "β (m1a)", "p", "Suppression")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#D3F4FF")
```

**Key findings:**
- **Light effect:** Highly consistent across models (both p < 0.001), stronger in robust model
- **Session effect:** Significant in full model (p = 0.031), not included in robust model (LRT p = 0.316)

**Result:** Full model showed significant quantile deviations; robust model passed all applicable tests.
